event.title: AFC President Criticizes FIFA's World Cup Stake Sale Plan
event.canonical_title: AFC President Criticizes FIFA's World Cup Stake Sale Plan
event.summary: The president of the Asian Football Confederation has condemned FIFA's proposal to sell stakes in the World Cup to private investors, describing the lack of consultation as 'totally unacceptable.' He argues that this plan undermines the continental structure of the sport.

timeline.title: UEFA Initiates Criminal Proceedings Against Gianni Infantino Over World Cup Stake Sale
timeline.summary: UEFA is preparing to file a criminal complaint in Swiss courts against FIFA President Gianni Infantino. The complaint arises from Infantino's failed attempt to sell a stake in World Cup revenues to private investors for $4.2 billion, which UEFA lawyers described as a 'fraudulently off-market price.'
key_facts: UEFA is preparing a criminal complaint against Gianni Infantino.
The complaint is related to a failed plan to sell World Cup revenue stakes.
The proposed sale price was $4.2 billion.
